author: Chris Titus Tech
description:
Three years in the making, this is the Linux desktop I use every day. Built around DWM, Quickshell, and a Fedora base, it brings together tiling windows, matching themes, display profiles, Bluetooth, audio, and system updates with minimal dependencies.

I'll walk through the setup, demonstrate a fresh installation, and show how I configure shortcuts, window rules, and layouts without recompiling DWM. I'll also explain why I moved from Arch to Fedora and why I'm still using X11.

This is a personal project in beta, with rough edges still to polish. Take what you like, customize it, or build something of your own.

Thanks to CodeRabbit for sponsoring this video.
